title: Gemini Pro models left the free API tier and now require billing
detail: Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Pro and Gemini 2.5 Pro all require a billing account from April 1, 2026. Flash and Flash-Lite stay free on tightened daily quotas, reported at 5 to 15 requests per minute and up to 1,000 requests per day. Sources also describe a free-tier quota cut of 50 to 80 percent from December 2025, and a mandatory monthly spending cap that pauses the API once reached.
impact: Any prototype or side project running on free Pro access stopped working that day unless billing was attached. Check whether a Flash model covers the job before paying for Pro.
